description: Every propositional formula has a semantically equivalent disjunctive and conjunctive normal form using no new atoms.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.formula_normal_forms.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  ∃ B C,
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.IsDnf B ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.IsCnf C ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.SemEquivalent A B ∧
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.SemEquivalent A C ∧
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms B ⊆ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms A ∧
              Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms C ⊆ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms A
